title: Transfer geometry-only mutation beyond damped push
hypothesis: Restricting mutations to object–goal-relative contact geometry transfers useful approach bias to other bank structures more reliably than equally constrained gain-and-damping edits.

prediction.against: Matched gain-and-damping-only LLM mutations of the same parents
prediction.rationale: A five-point scope contrast tests a mechanism absent from generic mutation and bounds-only experiments; a separate positive comparison with unedited parents prevents declaring a less harmful edit useful. Requires per-idea GPU and LLM approval; stop the remote box afterward.

protocol.command: gpu run -- python scripts/stage_f.py --config config/stage_f/stage_f.yaml --research-protocol mutation-scope-transfer --parents simple_reach_push_sharp_gate,simple_reach_push_shared_gain --scopes contact-geometry,gain-damping --children-per-parent-scope 2 --max-repair-per-candidate 0 --preserve-parameter-schema-bounds-initialization --fit-seeds 2920,2921 --probe-seed 2922 --confirmation-seed 2923 --probe-cases 10 --confirmation-cases 50 --checkpoints 0,500,1000 --max-fit-steps 1000 --no-screen-selection --llm-model gpt-6.1-sol --reasoning-effort high --temperature 1 --manifest-dir config/manifests/research/geometry_transfer --output logs/research/geometry_transfer_s2920
code_changes: scripts/stage_f.py: add the named scope-transfer protocol using existing bounded mutation, validation, fitting, and evaluation machinery; generate two independent children per parent per scope, with no correction evidence or retries.

scripts/stage_f.py: enforce matched edit-size limits and unchanged parameter schema, bounds, and initialization. Geometry edits may change contact-target construction but not gains, damping, or gates; control edits may change gain/damping algebra but not geometry or gates.

scripts/stage_f.py: fit eight children and two unedited parents under two matched seeds using fixed demonstrations; select checkpoints only on a disjoint development probe and score every arm on frozen confirmation cases without screening winners.

scripts/stage_f.py: treat invalid children as parent fallbacks without replacement calls; report intention-to-treat scope differences and geometry-versus-parent differences, averaging over parents, draws, and fitting seeds within placement. Do not promote children or change bank roles.

falsified_by: An upper paired 95% bound below +0.05 for geometry minus gain/damping refutes the predicted scope advantage. An upper bound at or below zero for geometry minus unedited parents refutes useful transfer. Zero-spanning intervals are inconclusive; ties are not improvements.
